column1: # Sample eval set for the Ep 9 assistive vendor-invoice reconciliation agent.
# The agent is conversational, not event-driven: a person uploads a vendor invoice, the
# agent runs two checks (the invoice matches the PO line in Finance & Operations, and
# the linked launch task is complete in Dataverse), records an in-flight task as complete
# only when the person confirms delivery, and only posts after the person explicitly
# confirms. On a go-ahead it posts the product receipt and then the vendor invoice. Each
# conversation below is multi-turn. Reference responses are for reviewers only; they are
# not compared to the agent reply.
# NOTE: the Copilot Studio eval import does not support file attachments, so each opening
# turn pastes the invoice details inline (vendor, project, PO, line, amount) rather than
# uploading a PDF. In the live test pane you instead upload the fixtures in
# sample-invoices/. The agent reads the invoice from an upload or from pasted details.
# Import in Copilot Studio (Agent > Test > Evaluations > Import), Conversations data
# type (the file carries a conversationNumber column, so Single responses rejects it).
# General Quality is added by default. Score conversations 2 (work-blocked hold),
# 4 (F&O unreachable), and 5 (post-without-confirm guardrail) with a manual or custom
# method: all three are correct hold / clarify / refusal behaviors, and General Quality
# structurally marks a hold, a clarifying question, or a refusal as a question not
# answered even though the agent did the right thing.
# Limitations: 8 Q&A pairs max per conversation, 50 conversations max, 500 chars per
# question. See https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2335991
conversationNumber

column3: Thanks. I marked the launch task (Hero copy + visuals) as Done in Dataverse on your confirmation. Both checks now pass: amount 22,000 matches the PO-10514 line, and the work is recorded complete. Do you want me to post the product receipt and vendor invoice in Finance & Operations?

Posting in the dat company through the ERP MCP form tools: first the product receipt against PO-10514 (line flips to Received), then the vendor invoice. Posted: PO-10514 flips to Invoiced and the accounts-payable liability is booked. I recorded the invoice and voucher numbers on the launch task for the audit trail.

column2: Where did the 22,000 figure come from?
column3: It is the PO-10514 line amount (LineAmount) read from PurchaseOrderLinesV2 in the dat company via the ERP MCP, and it matches the amount on the invoice you uploaded. The task status I read (and then set to Done on your confirmation) is lc_taskstatus on the linked lc_task via the Dataverse MCP.

column2: Which legal entity do you query in Finance & Operations, and why?
column3: I query the dat legal entity (company DAT). Every Launch Control PO, vendor, and posted invoice lives in dat; USMF is the F&O demo default and holds none of this data, so I constrain every read to dataAreaId eq 'dat'. If a read comes back empty I re-check the company is dat before concluding F&O is unreachable.
